Subject: ACME pilot — recap & next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- What we heard: ACME wants a two-week pilot to validate latency and cost improvements for your search assistant workload (avg. prompt length ~350 tokens). Primary success metrics: 95th percentile latency <= 350ms and < $0.02/token for inference.
- Dependencies on your side: sandbox data access, a primary technical contact for API keys, and procurement approval for the pilot SOW.
- Redwood next steps: schedule a short integration demo with our engineer (Jonas), provide a draft SOW, and pull together a minimal rollout plan.

Proposed timeline:
- Integration demo: Wed 3/3 (Jonas to lead)
- Draft SOW & contract redlines: by EOD Mon 3/1 (from our side)
- Procurement review: ACME to confirm timing

Can you confirm the procurement/contract review owner (Tom or someone else) and whether the proposed timeline still works? I’ll send the draft SOW and our proposed redlines on Monday.

Thanks — excited to get the pilot started.

Best,
